title: Glis1 inhibits RTEC cellular senescence and renal fibrosis by downregulating histone lactylation in DKD.
authors: Chen, Juan; He, Junling; Wang, Xiaoyue; Bai, Lihua; Yang, Xin; Chen, Jia; He, Yani; Chen, Kehong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Glis1通过下调组蛋白乳酸化抑制肾小管衰老和纤维化，虽涉及AlphaFold2/AutoDock预测蛋白-蛋白互作，但核心是蛋白-蛋白（Glis1-KAT5）而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Accelerated senescence of renal tubular epithelial cells (RTEC) is critical in the progression of diabetic kidney disease (DKD). GLIS family zinc finger 1 (Glis1) alleviates age-related renal fibrosis in naturally aged mice. However, the role and associated mechanism of Glis1 in accelerated senescence of RTEC and the development of DKD remain unclear. METHODS: Glis1 expression was examined in the renal tubules of patients with DKD and STZ-induced DKD mice. Glis1-CKO and Glis1-overexpression mice were generated to assess the effect of Glis1 on renal dysfunction and senescence in RTEC. The interplay between Glis1 and histone lactylation during cellular senescence was elucidated in vivo and in vitro. RESULTS: Glis1 expression was significantly decreased in RTEC of DKD and DKD mice. Glis1 overexpression alleviated renal dysfunction and accelerated RTEC senescence in DKD mice. Histone lactylation levels significantly increased in the kidneys of mice with DKD. Lactylation enhancers, including rotenone and nala, diminished the protective effects of Glis1 against cellular senescence, whereas treatment with sodium dichloroacetate, a lactylation inhibitor, enhanced Glis1's anti-senescence capabilities. Protein-protein interaction tools, AlphaFold2 and AutoDock, indicated that Glis1 might directly bind to the lactyltransferase KAT5 with multiple interaction sites. In vitro, the interaction between KAT5 and histone H3 was enhanced under high glucose conditions. However, Glis1 overexpression led to a significant reduction in the binding affinity between histones and KAT5, which could decrease lactylation levels. CONCLUSIONS: Glis1 inhibits tubular accelerated senescence by downregulating histone lactylation and alleviating kidney fibrosis during DKD progression.
abstract_zh: 背景：肾小管上皮细胞（RTEC）的加速衰老在糖尿病肾病（DKD）进展中至关重要。GLIS家族锌指蛋白1（Glis1）可缓解自然衰老小鼠中与年龄相关的肾纤维化。然而，Glis1在RTEC加速衰老及DKD发展中的作用及相关机制仍不清楚。方法：检测了DKD患者和STZ诱导的DKD小鼠肾小管中Glis1的表达。构建了Glis1-CKO和Glis1过表达小鼠，以评估Glis1对肾功能障碍和RTEC衰老的影响。在体内和体外阐明了Glis1与组蛋白乳酸化在细胞衰老过程中的相互作用。结果：在DKD患者和DKD小鼠的RTEC中，Glis1表达显著降低。Glis1过表达减轻了DKD小鼠的肾功能障碍和RTEC加速衰老。DKD小鼠肾脏中组蛋白乳酸化水平显著升高。乳酸化增强剂（包括鱼藤酮和nala）削弱了Glis1对细胞衰老的保护作用，而乳酸化抑制剂二氯乙酸钠处理则增强了Glis1的抗衰老能力。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用工具AlphaFold2和AutoDock表明，Glis1可能通过多个相互作用位点直接结合乳酸转移酶KAT5。在体外，高糖条件下KAT5与组蛋白H3的相互作用增强。然而，Glis1过表达导致组蛋白与KAT5之间的结合亲和力显著降低，这可能降低乳酸化水平。结论：Glis1通过下调组蛋白乳酸化抑制肾小管加速衰老，并在DKD进展过程中减轻肾纤维化。
